patch.value: Transfer selected retained citations as validated portable bundles

Export selected evidence artifacts with exact hashes, source descriptors, explicit sharing consent and omission policy. Validate complete bundles and explicit revision-bound target authorization before inspecting or importing.

Tampered bytes refuse before writes; export excludes unselected sources; a no-git recipient replays retained fragments without original files; revoked consent prevents new export; 500 seeded model sequences compare native SDK read-back; packed npm and Bun acceptance; unchanged full release thresholds

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: installed CLI SDK declarations expose native history replay, output receipts, fenced mutateItem, complete reads and artifact deduplication, but no retained citation transport. Existing pm-evidence replay requires a citation already on an item; pm-memory import/export transfers knowledge records and guidance, while context/review/rlm consume evidence. This feature transports explicitly selected evidence fragments and source identity on existing native items; no tracker creation or generic archive. Reuse citationSchema, replay, Store and SDK fenced mutation; preserve native relationships and unrelated fields. No pm-evidence entry exists in the older no-git audit, so direct non-git acceptance is required.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented explicit sharing grant/revoke, bounded hash-verified retained artifact bundles, compact CLI receipts and SDK inspect/import APIs. All transfer authorization and unchanged decisions read current native state under SDK fenced leases, using verified native history generation to reject ABA and stale retries; preview and apply share one planner. Target foreign evidence is preserved with a typed skip. Focused bundle and command tests pass; new bundle modules measured 100 percent statements/branches/functions/lines in the focused coverage run. Public snapshot at 2224762: 15 items, 37 read-only files verified unchanged, 6 cited artifacts, 5 explicitly exported, 1 excluded, 3964 bundle bytes, 360 retained bytes, 5 source-free SDK replays, zero retry additions, tamper refusal and revoked export refusal; metadata inspection 502 estimated tokens.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review round 1: the blocking finding violates additive ownership: evidence source discovery may add absent native file links but must preserve every existing path/scope annotation, including empty or absent notes. Package-wide search found a single writer projection in src/store.ts shared by import, consent, cite, check, review and criterion binding; all CLI and SDK mutation paths converge there. The model oracle also used incoming-favoring deduplication and lacked colliding native fixtures, so it must be strengthened without dropping existing assertions. Git status was clean and origin/main is already an ancestor (3 commits ahead, 0 behind), so no merge is needed. GitHub contains no actionable non-blocking review findings beyond the supplied orchestrator finding; all supplied findings will be addressed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Class fix and focused evidence: writeEvidence now uses SDK artifactKey on the current leased native file list, filters out already-owned identities before deduplication, and declares a files change only for actual additions. This covers all package mutation commands through their one shared projection. SDK ownership test passes 30 operation/note-domain combinations; peer annotations survive all eight CAS boundaries; CLI import/check and native JSON/TOON rendering pass in non-git trackers. The renderer test captures each native presentation before and after rather than hand-normalizing undefined versus null. The 500-sequence model now seeds colliding project/global identities, missing notes and native annotation revisions, comparing against an independent first-owner map. Packed local/global npm/Bun journeys seed source and recipient annotations. Behavioral revert in a disposable source copy replaces only writeEvidence with the pre-fix function: fail 1 with Native annotation changed; restoring the fixed function passes 1 across all 30 combinations. No existing tests or thresholds were weakened.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Full-gate diagnostic: the first npm run exposed a model-only ordering assumption and was stopped rather than consuming the host on a known failure. The oracle had sorted baseline native links before any evidence write, whereas the SDK native write preserves their insertion order. The independent reference now retains observed native ordering until a genuinely new file identity invokes SDK sorting. Added an exact native-array order assertion for imports with no absent identities. Annotation ownership assertions remain intact; no production behavior or test threshold was relaxed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Oracle refinement: SDK dedupeLinkedArtifacts preserves insertion order; sorting is a separate SDK operation and is not part of native evidence publication. The model now keeps a first-owner insertion-ordered map, observes native annotation edits through the SDK, and adds only missing cited identities on any target evidence mutation. This corrects the earlier sorting assumption in the diagnostic comment. The full model is being run standalone to completion before restarting either full release gate; production remains the same SDK-key ownership fix.

No additional non-blocking findings were supplied or found in GitHub review comments; the supplied additive-ownership class is addressed in every shared writer path.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Compatibility completion of the same additive-ownership class: the public SDK canonical document and mutation APIs accept legacy file collections containing multiple rows with the same path/scope and distinct annotations. Deduplicating the entire native collection when adding a new source can discard such a foreign row. The writer now leaves the complete existing native list untouched and deduplicates only package-owned additions. Added a real-SDK legacy duplicate fixture covering both CAS check recording and locked bundle import. The 9aed762 CI run passed npm on Node 22 and the Node 26 npm step; Bun is still running. These results are prior-head evidence and do not approve the final compatibility completion. The original post-push waiting cutoff is retained.
